resume_note: Actor, critic, optimizers, league and learner RNG retained. Worker count changes from 8 to 16; simulator workers start fresh with a new explicit seed, avoiding replay of their initial seed streams.
selection_rationale: Neural-heavy pilot beat control on broad schedules by 3.83 points (95% paired interval 0.31 to 7.34) and frozen-imitation matches by 7.03 points (1.56 to 12.5). Its core result was 2.34 points lower (interval -8.20 to 3.52). Exploratory single-seed evidence, not a claim of universal mixture superiority.
promotion_criteria: Retain the v7 experiment protocol: paired gains over frozen v6 on broad and held-out core schedules, preserve saved-roster strength, then freeze a candidate before prospective test_v7. Do not select on training win rate or consume the test during training.
critic_and_search: Public advantages retained while private advantage is uncertain; search off, no search distillation.
verification: Full regression suite: 72 passed. V6 baseline and prospective-test manifest hashes unchanged.
